hero.title: Japan Trip: Tokyo → Hokkaido Loop
hero.description: Estimated total cost: 5470 EUR (With Japan Experience: 7551 EUR)

cards.title: Tokyo (arrival)
cards.description: 4 nights in Ryogoku with a Skytree view. One area per day so there's no running around: Akihabara and Skytree, Kamakura and Enoshima, Harry Potter and Shibuya, then Odaiba before the Shinkansen.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Daiichi Hotel Ryogoku (4 nights, Oct 24-28) - booked, double room with Skytree view

items.text: 1-6-1 Yokoami, Sumida - JR Ryogoku station ~9 min on foot (East exit)

sections.title: Day 1 - Transport
items: Landing at Haneda (HND): Japan Experience agent after customs with a sign showing your name (don't leave the airport without meeting them)
They hand over the travel book, the tickets (Shinkansen, ferry, JAL flight), the preloaded IC card and the pocket Wi-Fi
Shared shuttle Haneda → hotel: pickup time emailed the evening before from 18:00 (check spam)
Allow 1h30 to 2h30 between landing and the shuttle leaving
Japan Experience assistance: WhatsApp +81 90 3823 1949 (8:00-22:00)

sections.title: Sat Oct 24 - Settling in at Ryogoku
items: Check-in from 15:00 (bags can be left earlier)

items.text: Walk around the sumo district and the Ryogoku Kokugikan
Chanko-nabe dinner, the wrestlers' hotpot and the local speciality

items: Quiet evening, the Skytree lit up from the room

sections.title: Sun Oct 25 - Akihabara (Owl Cafe 2pm), Asakusa and Skytree at sunset
items: Everything is around the hotel, 5-15 min from one spot to the next: Ueno → Akihabara → Asakusa → Skytree

items.text: Slow morning (jet lag): Ueno Park and Ameyoko market - Oedo line Ryogoku → Ueno-Okachimachi (~6 min)
Walk down to Akihabara along Ameyoko (~15 min)
~12:00: lunch at Sushiro Akihabara Ekimae, 1 min from JR Akihabara south exit - grab a ticket in the Sushiro app, Sundays mean a wait
13:50: Owl Cafe Akiba Fukurou - BOOKED for 14:00 (67 Kanda Neribeicho, 3 min from JR Akihabara, Central Gate). Arrive 10 min early
Optional: Don Quijote Akihabara, cosplay and costume floor (well-stocked for Halloween in late October)
~15:30: Tsukuba Express Akihabara → Asakusa (~5 min): Senso-ji and Nakamise-dori (busy on Sundays, but it's on the way)
Cross the Sumida on the Azuma bridge and walk to the Skytree (~20 min)
~16:30: Tokyo Skytree, Tembo Deck (350 m) + Tembo Galleria (450 m). Sunset around 16:50, then the city lights up. Timed tickets, buy online

items: Dinner at Tokyo Solamachi at the foot of the tower. Back to Ryogoku in ~15 min (Hanzomon line to Kinshicho + 1 stop on JR Sobu, or taxi)

sections.title: Mon Oct 26 - Kamakura, Hokoku-ji and Enoshima
items: A day down south, east to west: Hokoku-ji → central Kamakura → Great Buddha → Enoshima for sunset
~08:00: JR Sobu Ryogoku → Kinshicho (1 stop), then the direct JR Yokosuka line to Kamakura (~1h)

items.text: Hokoku-ji, the bamboo temple: be there when it opens (9:00) before the crowds, matcha in the tea house among the bamboo. Taxi ~7 min from the station, or bus to Jomyoji
Tsurugaoka Hachimangu then Komachi-dori: shirasu-don lunch (whitebait, the local speciality)
Enoden Kamakura → Hase: the Great Buddha (Kotoku-in) and Hase-dera temple with its sea view
Enoden Hase → Enoshima (~20 min, the little train along the sea): the bridge, the shrine, then the Sea Candle at sunset (~16:50), Fuji visible on clear days

items: Back: Odakyu Katase-Enoshima → Shinjuku (~1h10), then JR Sobu straight to Ryogoku (~25 min). Optional: dinner in Shinjuku on the way (Omoide Yokocho)

sections.title: Tue Oct 27 - Harry Potter, then Shibuya
items: Morning in the north-west, evening in Shibuya, linked by a direct train
Getting there: Toei Oedo line from Ryogoku to Toshimaen (~50 min, cross-platform change at Tochomae)

items.text: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo - The Making of Harry Potter: slot around 10:00, allow ~4h (Butterbeer and lunch on site). Timed tickets, official website only, non-refundable

items: Afterwards: Seibu Toshimaen → Nerima (1 stop), then a direct Fukutoshin line train to Shibuya (~30 min)

items.text: Shibuya Crossing at dusk (~17:00): free view from above through the glass walkway in Shibuya Mark City, or Shibuya Sky (paid) for the rooftop
Hachiko statue, Center Gai and Shibuya 109
Evening: Nonbei Yokocho, an alley of tiny 6-8 seat bars, more intimate than Golden Gai
To end the night: up the Dogenzaka hill (5 min on foot) - themed hotels, 2-3h “rest” rate

items: Back to Ryogoku: Hanzomon line direct to Kinshicho (~30 min) + 1 stop on JR Sobu

sections.title: Wed Oct 28 - Odaiba, then the 18:12 Shinkansen
items: Check out in the morning. Tokyo Station is on the way to Odaiba: drop the suitcases there on the way out, pick them up on the way back, no detour
~09:30: JR Sobu Ryogoku → Akihabara, then JR Yamanote or Keihin-Tohoku → Tokyo (~20 min). Luggage: the large lockers go fast, or use a staffed baggage counter / book ecbo cloak
Tokyo → Shimbashi (JR, 2 stops), then the Yurikamome, the driverless train that crosses the Rainbow Bridge

items.text: ~10:30: Small Worlds Tokyo (Ariake), the world's largest indoor miniature museum. Allow ~2h. Open 9:00-19:00, tickets online
After lunch, Yurikamome to Odaiba-kaihinkoen (~10 min): Odaiba Retro Museum, recreated Showa-era streets (4th floor of DECKS Tokyo Beach, 11:00-20:00, ~1h, JPY 1,300, no booking needed)
Walk on Odaiba beach facing the Rainbow Bridge, and the giant Gundam outside DiverCity (Daiba station)

items: ~16:30: Yurikamome → Shimbashi → Tokyo (~25 min), pick up the suitcases

items.text: Buy an ekiben (station bento) for dinner on the train at Ekibenya Matsuri. Plan B: Sushiro Yaechika, under the station (Yaesu side)

items: 17:50 at the latest on the Joetsu Shinkansen platform: the Toki 337 leaves at 18:12

sections.title: Extra ideas (if you feel like it or the weather turns)
items: Miraikan (the museum of the future) is closed for renovation from Oct 1, 2026 to Apr 22, 2027

items.text: teamLab Planets (Toyosu) instead: immersive digital art, on the same Yurikamome line as Odaiba - timed tickets, you walk barefoot
Hakone Yuryo private onsen, for a relaxing half-day for two (1h30 from Tokyo, online booking)
Gotokuji, the temple of thousands of maneki-neko cats, then Shimokitazawa (thrift shops, record stores, cafes)
Yanaka Ginza and sunset on the Yuyake Dandan steps (Nippori, 10 min from Akihabara)

cards.title: Shinkansen + overnight ferry to Hokkaido
cards.description: Shinkansen to Niigata, then the overnight ferry with a stop in Akita and a day at sea. Arrival in Tomakomai-Higashi the next day at 16:45.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Shin Nihonkai ferry Niigata → Tomakomai - Deluxe Twin cabin, single use (booked)

sections.title: Transport
items: Wed Oct 28, 18:12: Shinkansen Toki 337, Tokyo Station → Niigata (arrives 20:07). Reserved seat, ordinary class, ticket handed over on arrival
Be on the platform by 17:50. The IC card doesn't work on the Shinkansen: use the ticket
Niigata: taxi from the station to the ferry terminal (~15 min, 4 km). Be at the port by 21:00 (1h30 before departure)
22:30: Shin Nihonkai ferry departs (ship Lilac / Yukari)
Thu Oct 29: stop in Akita around 05:00, then 16:45 arrival at Tomakomai-Higashi port (~18h crossing)

sections.title: On-board activities
items: Relax on the deck
Restaurant and common areas (meals not included)
Stop in Akita at dawn, then a full day at sea along the coast
Sunrise at sea

sections.title: After arrival
items: Donan Bus connecting bus in front of the terminal → JR Minami-Chitose station (~45 min, JPY 1,500 cash or PayPay, no IC card). It leaves once passengers are off the ship
JR Rapid Airport Minami-Chitose → Sapporo (~35 min)
Check in at the Sapporo Tokyu REI Hotel around 19:00
Heads-up: the travel book says bus no. 24 to Tomakomai station, but that is the West port access. The Niigata ferry arrives at Tomakomai-Higashi, ~30 km from town

cards.title: Sapporo
cards.description: 3 nights at the Tokyu REI, right in Susukino: the city at golden-ginkgo time, and a day in Otaru.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Sapporo Tokyu REI Hotel (3 nights, Oct 29 - Nov 1) - booked

items.text: Minami 4-jo Nishi 5-chome, Chuo-ku (Susukino)

sections.title: Day 6 (Thu Oct 29) - Evening in Susukino

items.text: Arriving ~19:00: miso ramen, THE Sapporo speciality, at Ganso Ramen Yokocho (ramen alley, 5 min from the hotel)
Or jingisukan (lamb grilled on a cast-iron dome) at Daruma, Susukino's cult spot - queues in the evening

items: Walk under the Susukino neon

items.text: Kaisendon breakfast (seafood bowl) at Nijo Market
Odori Park, the TV Tower and the Clock Tower (quick, it's small)
Hokkaido University ginkgo avenue: the golden leaves peak in late October, right this week. 10 min on foot from Sapporo station
Soup curry lunch, Sapporo's other speciality (e.g. Soup Curry GARAKU)
Tanukikoji, the covered shopping arcade (handy if it rains)
Sapporo Beer Museum (free, paid tasting), then jingisukan dinner at the Sapporo Beer Garden next door
Evening: night view from Mt Moiwa (ropeway + mini cable car, last ascent 21:30). Tram to Ropeway-iriguchi then free shuttle
Optional: Hitsujigaoka Observation Hill and the Clark statue

sections.title: Day 8 (Sat Oct 31) - Transport
items: JR train Sapporo → Otaru (~35 min by rapid, IC card)

sections.title: Day 8 (Sat Oct 31) - Otaru

items.text: Optional in the morning: Nikka distillery in Yoichi (JR Otaru → Yoichi, ~25 min). Museum and shop need no booking; the free guided tour needs a reservation and is in Japanese
Kaisendon lunch at Sankaku Market, right next to Otaru station
Walk down to the canal: stone warehouses and gas lamps
Sakaimachi street: Kitaichi Glass, LeTAO (the double cheesecake), the music box museum and its steam clock

items: The canal at dusk (~16:30), when the lamps come on

items.text: Sushi dinner in Otaru (Sushi-ya dori) before heading back, or back to Sapporo

items: Get ready to leave: the car pickup is at 9:00 the next morning

cards.title: Sapporo → Sounkyo Onsen
cards.description: Car pickup, Asahiyama Zoo on the way (last days of its summer season) and a night at an onsen hotel in the gorge.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Sounkyo Choyo Resort Hotel - twin room, half-board (1 night, Nov 1-2) - booked

sections.title: Transport
items: Sun Nov 1, 09:00: car pickup at Toyota Rent a Car Sapporo Ekimae (Kita 5-jo Higashi 1-2-4) - Toyota voucher required
Do-o Expressway to Asahikawa (~1h50, 140 km), then the free expressway and Route 39 to Sounkyo (~1h)
Arrival at Sounkyo Onsen around 15:00, dark by ~16:30
Cost: ~50 EUR (fuel + tolls)

sections.title: Stops en route

items.text: ~11:00: Asahiyama Zoo, Japan's most famous (polar bears, seals swimming through a tube, penguins). Summer season until Nov 3 (9:30-16:30), closed Nov 4-10: Nov 1 is fine. Allow 2h
Lunch at Asahikawa Ramen Village: 8 shops serving Asahikawa shoyu ramen, on the way to Sounkyo
Optional: Otokoyama sake brewery (free museum, shop) - tasting for the passenger only

items: Early November can bring snow at altitude: check the car has winter tyres

sections.title: Activities
items: Hotel check-in (free parking)

items.text: If you arrive before ~15:30: Kurodake ropeway up to 1,300 m, sunset over the Daisetsuzan (check the last ascent time)

items: Onsen in the evening
Dinner included (half-board)

cards.title: Sounkyo Onsen → Akan-ko
cards.description: The big driving day: waterfalls, a mountain aquarium, lakes Kussharo and Mashu, a steaming volcano. Leave early, it gets dark around 16:15 in the east.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Akan no Mori Tsuruga Resort Hanayuka - Japanese-style room, breakfast included (3 nights, Nov 2-5) - booked

sections.title: Transport
items: 08:30: leave Sounkyo
~4h of driving (260 km) + stops: arrival in Akan around 16:00
Check-in from 15:00 (Akanko Onsen 1-6-1)
Avoid driving after dark: lots of deer on the road at dusk
Cost: ~45 EUR (fuel)

items.text: Ryusei and Ginga falls, 5 min past Sounkyo: the "husband and wife falls" (parking on Route 39)
Onneyu Onsen: Yama no Suizokukan, a small mountain aquarium known for its giant itou fish (~45 min, ~JPY 700). Skip it if you're running late
Bihoro Pass: the panorama over the whole of Lake Kussharo
Lake Kussharo: Sunayu (dig into the beach and hot water wells up) and the Wakoto peninsula
Mt. Io (Iozan): yellow sulphur vents right by the car park, eggs steamed by the volcano
Lake Mashu, observatory no. 1: one of the clearest lakes in the world, often in the mist
Sogakudai on Route 241: view of the Oakan and Meakan volcanoes just before Akan

sections.title: Activities at Akan
items: Hotel check-in (free parking)
Onsen with lake view

items.text: Dinner not included (breakfast only): Ainu cuisine at Poronno in the Ainu Kotan

cards.title: Akan-ko
cards.description: Lake Akan and Ainu culture, then a day towards Kushiro for the cranes and the great marsh.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Akan no Mori Tsuruga Resort Hanayuka

sections.title: Day 11 (Tue Nov 3, holiday) - Akan

items.text: Morning: Lake Onneto (~30 min drive), its water changes colour with the light, Mt Meakan behind. The road closes in December, November is fine
Lake Akan cruise (~85 min) with a stop on Churui island to see the marimo, the giant algae balls. Until Nov 30, no booking needed
Bokke trail (~1h on foot from the Eco Museum Center): little bubbling mud volcanoes on the lakeshore
Ainu Kotan, the Ainu village: wood-carving workshops
15:00: "Lost Kamuy" at the Ikor theatre (dance and projections, ~40 min). 15:00 show on weekends and holidays, otherwise 21:15. Traditional dances only resume in December

items: Onsen in the evening

sections.title: Day 12 (Wed Nov 4) - Kushiro: cranes and marsh
items: A day south on Route 240, back in Akan around nightfall

items.text: Akan International Crane Center (~45 min): Japan's red-crowned cranes (tancho). Winter feeding starts in November, best chances in the morning
Kushiro Marsh, the largest in Japan: Kushiro Shitsugen observatory, or Hosooka for the widest view
Lunch at Washo Market: katte-don, you build your own raw-fish bowl stall by stall
Sunset on Nusamai Bridge (~16:15), one of Japan's most famous sunsets

items: Back to Akan (~1h15): careful, deer on the road at night

sections.title: Alternative for day 12

items.text: Hike Mt. Oakan (4-5h) if there's no snow at the top - ask at the Eco Museum Center

items: Or a quiet day: onsen and village

cards.title: Akan-ko → Furano
cards.description: Across the Tokachi plain: wine, butadon and sweets, then the Karikachi pass to Furano.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Dormy Inn Premium La Vista Furano Hills - double room, breakfast included (2 nights, Nov 5-7) - booked

sections.title: Transport
items: 09:00: leave Akan-ko (check-out before 10:00)
~4h of driving (240 km): arrival in Furano around 16:30
Karikachi pass (644 m): snow possible in early November, check the road weather
Cost: ~60 EUR (fuel + tolls)

items.text: Ashoro: break at the Ginga Hall 21 michi-no-eki (roadside station)
Ikeda Wine Castle: Tokachi's wine château, cellars and shop (tasting for the passenger)
Obihiro, lunch: butadon, the grilled pork bowl with sweet sauce born in Obihiro (Pancho or Butadon no Ippin)
Rokkatei's flagship store in Obihiro: the marusei butter sandwich, THE Hokkaido sweet souvenir
Optional: Tokachigawa Onsen and its brown "moor" water (15 min east of Obihiro)
Karikachi Pass: a last look over the Tokachi plain before dropping into Furano

sections.title: Activities in Furano

items.text: Check in at the Dormy Inn (Asahimachi 5-14)
Dinner: Furano omu-curry (omelette, rice and curry), the town's speciality

items: The hotel onsen, and free late-night ramen (yonaki soba, a Dormy Inn habit)

cards.title: Furano & Biei
cards.description: Cheese factory, the Biei hills facing snowy peaks, and the Blue Pond lit up after dark.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Dormy Inn Premium La Vista Furano Hills

sections.title: Day 14 (Fri Nov 6) - Furano & Biei
items: Out of flower season: no lavender in November, but bare rolling hills and often the first white peaks

items.text: 09:00: Furano Cheese Factory, cheese, ice cream and wood-fired pizza
Furano Winery, the town's winery: tasting and a view over Furano
Farm Tomita, on the way north: no flower fields, but the lavender greenhouse, the shop and the café
Biei, Panorama Road and Shikisai-no-oka: rolling hills facing the Tokachidake range
Lunch in Biei: curry udon, the local speciality
Patchwork Road: the famous trees (Ken & Mary, Seven Stars) and the Hokusei-no-oka lookout
Shirogane: Shirahige falls and the blue torrent under the bridge, then a soak at Shirogane Onsen while it gets dark
17:00: the Blue Pond lit up - Oct 22 to Apr 21, 17:00-21:00 in November. Back to Furano ~45 min

items: Ningle Terrace is closed Nov 5-27 (annual maintenance)

cards.title: Furano → Sapporo
cards.description: Back to Sapporo via an open-air museum, the car to return before 19:00, last evening in Susukino.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Sapporo Tokyu REI Hotel (1 night, Nov 7-8) - booked

sections.title: Transport
items: 10:00: leave Furano (check-out)
~2h30 to Sapporo (140 km) via Takikawa and the Do-o Expressway
Return the car to Toyota Sapporo Ekimae before 19:00 (tank full; ETC tolls are charged to your card at that point)
Cost: ~30 EUR (fuel + tolls)

sections.title: Stops en route

items.text: Historical Village of Hokkaido (Nopporo, on the edge of Sapporo): some fifty pioneer-era buildings in an open-air museum. Open on Saturdays, 9:00-16:30 (closed Mondays from October to April)
Optional with the car: Moerenuma Park, Isamu Noguchi's sculpture park and its glass pyramid

items: Asahiyama Zoo is closed Nov 4-10: do it on the way out (day 9)

sections.title: Activities in Sapporo
items: Hotel check-in
Last souvenirs: Shiroi Koibito, Royce, Rokkatei at Sapporo station and Daimaru

items.text: Last dinner: jingisukan at Daruma if you haven't yet, or crab in Susukino

items: Free evening in Susukino

cards.title: Sapporo → Tokyo, Ikebukuro base
cards.description: JAL flight to Haneda and 2 nights in Ikebukuro: guided walk in Shinjuku, Kawagoe and its eel, the Kochikame museum in Kameari.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Hotel Resol Ikebukuro (2 nights, Nov 8-10) - booked

items.text: 2-30-14 Minami-Ikebukuro, Toshima - 6 min on foot from JR Ikebukuro, 1 min from Higashi-Ikebukuro (Yurakucho line, exit 1)

sections.title: Transport (Sun Nov 8)
items: Private shuttle hotel → New Chitose (CTS): time emailed the day before, by 17:30. Plan B: JR Rapid Airport from Sapporo station (37 min)
11:40: JAL 508 Sapporo (CTS) → Tokyo Haneda (HND), arrives 13:25. Be at the airport 1h30 to 2h before
Shuttle Haneda → hotel in Ikebukuro: time emailed the day before, by 17:30

sections.title: Sun Nov 8 - Night walk in Shinjuku
items: Ikebukuro → Shinjuku: JR Yamanote or Saikyo (~6 min)

items.text: 18:30-20:00: guided night walk in Shinjuku (Japan Experience, in English). Meet outside Uniqlo Shinjuku West Exit: the store is under renovation, look for the Japan Experience sign. Arrive 10 min early
Afterwards: dinner in Omoide Yokocho, or head back to Ikebukuro

sections.title: Mon Nov 9 - Kawagoe and Ogakiku's eel
items: Ikebukuro is the gateway to Kawagoe: Tobu Tojo Line to Kawagoe (~30 min by express), then bus or ~20 min on foot to the old town

items.text: Ogakiku, eel since 1807: arrive before opening (11:00 on weekdays, lunch service until 14:00). Unaju JPY 3,950 to 6,500. Closed on Thursdays
After lunch, head north: Taisho Roman street, the Kurazukuri warehouse houses, the Toki no Kane bell tower
Kashiya Yokocho, the old-fashioned candy alley
Optional: Kita-in temple and its 500 Rakan statues

items: Back to Ikebukuro mid-afternoon, free evening

sections.title: Tue Nov 10 - Kochikame, Shibamata, then the airport
items: Check out in the morning, leave the bags at reception
Ikebukuro → Nishi-Nippori (JR Yamanote), then the Chiyoda / Joban line to Kameari (~40 min)

items.text: 10:00: KochiKame Museum, 3 min from Kameari station (JPY 700, 10:00-18:00, closed on the 3rd Tuesday of the month: Nov 10 is the 2nd). Plus the hunt for the Ryotsu statues around the station
Optional, close by: Shibamata, retro shopping street and Taishakuten temple - pure Showa vibes (bus ~10 min, or JR to Kanamachi + 1 Keisei stop)

items: Back to Ikebukuro in the afternoon, pick up the bags
Shared shuttle hotel → Haneda: pickup ~3h30 before the flight, so around 19:15 (exact time emailed the evening before between 18:00 and 20:00). Be ready 10 min early

items.text: Kichijoji: Harmonica Yokocho and the Inokashira swan boats (legend says couples who ride them break up...)
Koenji: punk thrift shops and tiny neighbourhood bars, the locals' Tokyo
Nakano Broadway: retro mall, vintage toys, second-hand manga
Todoroki Valley: a real wooded ravine in the middle of the city
Kiyosumi-Shirakawa: roaster cafes, Kiyosumi garden, galleries
Kagurazaka in the evening: cobbled lanes, old geisha-district feel
Round1: bowling, darts and arcade under one roof

sections.title: Transport
items: Tue Nov 10, 22:45: flight NH203 Tokyo Haneda → Frankfurt
Connection in Frankfurt (3h35)
Flight LH9528 Frankfurt → Luxembourg, arrives Wed Nov 11 at 09:55

sections.title: Duration
items: 18 days / 17 nights

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Tokyo: 4 nights in Ryogoku (arrival) + 2 nights in Ikebukuro (return)
Ferry Niigata → Tomakomai: 1 night
Sapporo: 3 nights + 1 night
Sounkyo Onsen: 1 night
Akan-ko: 3 nights
Furano: 2 nights

sections.title: Main transport
items: Shinkansen Tokyo → Niigata, then overnight ferry Niigata → Tomakomai
Toyota rental car in Hokkaido (Nov 1-7)
JAL flight Sapporo → Tokyo

sections.title: Cities / places
items: Tokyo, Kamakura, Enoshima, Kawagoe
Niigata, Sapporo, Otaru, Sounkyo Onsen
Lake Kussharo, Mt. Io, Lake Mashu
Akan-ko, Obihiro, Biei, Furano

items: 5470 EUR
